DLC2323:4:t_010:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You got time to run your mouth on a mission?」

DLC2323:4:t_010:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As $$マリリン$$ used to say, 'We carry out our mission in a flash...'」

DLC2323:4:t_010:17.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「'By the time you notice, it's already a raging blaze...'」

DLC2323:4:t_010:18.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「'By the time you raise the alarm, it's already too late...'」

DLC2323:4:t_010:19.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「'That's how $$ファイヤバグ$$ does its work, sweetie!б' Right!」

DLC2323:4:t_010:20.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Another unit is already on its way to defend the base! We'll take down $$サイデリアル$$!」

DLC2323:4:t_011:1.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「This fiery planet is where our $$姫$$ rests, and the new home of $$インサラウム$$'s people... We will not let anyone lay waste to it.」

DLC2323:4:t_011:2.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「Great victory is great justice! Long live $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

DLC2323:4:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You lot... Get out of your machines.」

DLC2323:4:t_013:2.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「What are you doing, little $$クロウ$$!?」

DLC2323:4:t_013:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the trouble dealt with. Let's head back to the base.」

DLC2323:4:t_013:8.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I would like you to accompany us as well.」

DLC2323:4:t_013:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not enough of a monster to abandon you in the Martian wilderness.」

DLC2323:4:t_013:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Besides, I have to deal with the rest of your guys defending the base too.」

DLC2323:4:t_014:0.en:
$$マルグリット$$
（Your Highness... All the people of $$インサラウム$$ have inherited your ideals.）

DLC2323:4:t_014:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
（$$ユーサー$$... Those people you loved are doing just fine.）

DLC2323:4:t_014:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
（$$マリリン$$... $$ファイヤバグ$$'s gone. I'll hear your complaints in hell someday.）

DLC2323:4:t_014:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
（$$ガイオウ$$... I'll go settle things with that $$根源的災厄$$ you told me about.）

DLC2323:4:t_014:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
（Well then... We're off. Wish us... wish humanity victory.）

DLC2323:4:t_100:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is a good opportunity. I'll finish you off right here.」

DLC2323:4:t_100:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just wait, $$マリリン$$! I'll bring the destruction of $$ファイヤバグ$$ to your grave as an offering!」

DLC2323:4:t_101:0.en:
$n
（Not long after I started piloting $$ジェニオン$$, we fought $$ファイヤバグ$$ once...）

DLC2323:4:t_101:1.en:
$n
（Now I'll see just how much I've closed the gap in strength I felt back then!）

DLC2323:4:t_102:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
（$$マリリン$$... That was a pretty classy parting gift you left us.）

DLC2323:4:t_102:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
（But that's one thing, and this is another. I'm ending $$ファイヤバグ$$ with my own hands.）

DLC2323:4:t_103:0.en:
$$マルグリット$$
（His Highness changed even $$マリリン・キャット$$... And now that has become a force that protects the people of $$インサラウム$$...）

DLC2323:4:t_103:1.en:
$$マルグリット$$
（I will fight too...! I will carry on His Highness's wishes, for the people...!）

DLC2323:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
（Watch us, $$姫$$...! We will stake our lives on carrying out this mission!）

DLC2323:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
（We fight with the $$姫$$'s words in our hearts!）

DLC2323:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
（The nature of the mission does not matter...! We will simply carry out the $$姫$$'s words faithfully!）

DLC2323:4:t_105:1.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
（Oh, $$姫$$...! Allow us to bring word of victory to your grave!）

DLC2323:4:t_106:1.en:
$$ＦＢ隊員$$
「I'd die for the $$姫$$'s orders! No, go ahead and kill meeeee!!」

review.context: Firebug completes Marilyn last mission; Crowe orders its members to dismount before destroying their machines, then pays respects to the dead and leaves for the next battle.
decisions: Preserved the unusual source Cyrillic б glyph after the quoted Marilyn catchphrase.
Crowe destroys empty machines after warning the pilots to stay down; the pilots survive to be offered work in the framing scene.
Primordial Calamity follows the proposed term agreed with the orchestrator.
uncertainties: The б glyph appears to be a special-display symbol; retained exactly for renderer review.
